Container.Name: LanGuard-Backend
Container.Overview:
LanGuard Backend is the core API, database engine, and integration hub for LanGuard.
[b]NOTE:[/b] This is the backend component of the LanGuard stack. It should be deployed alongside [b]LanGuard[/b] (frontend) and [b]LanGuard-Scanner[/b]. Runs on the host network with privileged access to perform network-level operations.
[b]Credits & Support:[/b] - Created by [b]Yossi Hillali[/b] ([url=https://github.com/hillaliy/LanGuard]GitHub[/url]). Support the developer on [url=https://www.paypal.me/hillaliy]PayPal[/url]. - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: languard backend api network monitor scanner

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Long random secret key used for session signing and cryptographic tokens (generate e.g. with 'openssl rand -base64 48'). Must be identical to the one in LanGuard-Scanner.

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of hostnames or IP addresses allowed to reach the API (must include 127.0.0.1 for health checks).

Config.Name: Backend Listen Port
Config.Description: Port on which the backend Granian WSGI web server listens (default 8000).

Config.Name: AppData Database
Config.Description: Storage path for SQLite database (db.sqlite3) and application logs. Must be shared with LanGuard-Scanner.
